question: What is the language of the card that has azorius watermark? List out the type of this card.
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching foreign_data record.
gold: SELECT DISTINCT T2.language, T1.type FROM cards AS T1 LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T1.watermark = 'azorius'
gold0: SELECT DISTINCT T2.language, T1.type FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T1.watermark = 'azorius'

c.request:
What is the language of the card that has azorius watermark? List out the type of this card.
Also keep rows that have no matching foreign_data record.
c.sql: SELECT f.language, c.type FROM cards c LEFT JOIN foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.watermark = 'azorius'

d.request: What is the language of the card that has the Azorius watermark, and what is its type? Include cards that have no matching foreign_data record (i.e., keep those rows even if there is no language information).
d.sql: SELECT f.language, c.type FROM cards c LEFT JOIN foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.watermark = 'azorius'

b.request: For the cards with the Azorius watermark, list each card's language from its foreign_data records (keeping cards that have no matching foreign_data record, so language may be empty) along with the card's type
b.sql: SELECT f.language, c.type FROM cards AS c LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.watermark = 'azorius'
